scenario.limitations: The three user-defined weights are portfolio proxies, not official industry weights. Residual allocation assumes zero change solely for illustration.

hypothesis: A flat aggregate can hide opposite sector movements; investable implications depend on economic weights and persistence, not raw percentage changes.
alternative: Different sector output shares, seasonal adjustment, index aggregation and petroleum supplier demand can explain aggregate stability.
falsifier: Official weighted contribution series show negligible sector concentration or subsequent months reverse the divergence.
